chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Basie asks him to come east as Lips Page leaves
summary: Basie asked him to join for New York because Lips Page was going out on his own; Clayton found Kansas City a far more swinging town than Los Angeles.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I hardly remember myself. So then I went back to Kansas City and Basie asked me would I got to New York with him since he was leaving for New York shortly. In about five weeks Basie was supposed to leave for New York.
Now, one reason he's asking you is, wasn't Lips Page supposed to go along?
What was the story, what was the i.......
Well Lips had been in the band.
He was going on his own.

Yes. You see now, he wanted to be like Louis. Kind of special. Because he sang and he just didn't think that he could make it with Basie playing, sitting there playing parts. So Joe Glazer had him come to New York and Basie was left with a, he needed a trumpet.
So then he asked me would I, would I, since he's essentially going to New York and since we're going into the Roseland Ballroom.
Was this the first time you met Basie?
Yes. Yes, Kansas City was a swinging, swinging town. Much more swinging than Los Angeles, I mean as far as guys jamming.
They would jam all night and all morning, any time of the day, you could find them. Charlie Parker, Joe Jones, Lester. They had battles, you know. They would stay up until one o'clock, two o'clock.
